name: HealthView
intent: Grouped rule findings with severity, the element each one points at, and a jump-to-element action.
when: Surfacing rule violations over a model the user can repair
Any health or readiness panel over a rule engine
whenNot: Reporting one error in place -> use Alert
Ranking by duration rather than rule -> use the bottlenecks section

chooseOver.because: Each finding carries the element it points at, so the panel can jump the user to the thing that needs repairing rather than describing it.

onOpenElement.note: Jump to the object, link, action or interface a finding names.

dataContract.rowIdentity: Findings are keyed by rule plus target.

states.findings: Grouped by rule, each naming its target.
states.ontologyWide: A finding with no single target is attributed to the ontology itself.

forbiddenPlacement: a dashboard tile that cannot navigate
evaluationCriteria: Every finding is actionable — it names an element or the ontology itself.

lineage.authoredBy: Promoted from the WC3 ontology health tab (2026-08-26)
notes: Pairs with processGraphLint in wc3-process-shared.tsx, which renders its findings a second, different way — a two-copy case in waiting.
Promoted in group B of the missing-widgets template review.
